sloka: न अराजके जन पदे कारयन्ति सभाम् नराः ।उद्यानानि च रम्याणि हृष्टाः पुण्य गृहाणि च ॥२-६७-१२॥
transliteration: na arājake jana pade kārayanti sabhām narāḥ ।udyānāni ca ramyāṇi hṛṣṭāḥ puṇya gṛhāṇi ca ॥2-67-12॥

translations.english: In a country where there is no king, no assemblies are convened by pleasure seeking people, nor do they build delightful gardens or sacred edifices.
